echo '== nvidia-smi topo -p2p r'; nvidia-smi topo -p2p r || echo "AR_P2P_QUERY_FAILED $?"

n=$(nvidia-smi -L | grep -o 'UUID: GPU-[0-9a-f-]*' | sort -u | wc -l)
